<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sliding_cabinet">

  <!-- Base cabinet body -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.77 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="light_wood">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.7 0.5 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.77 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approximate mass 80 kg, uniform density -->
      <mass value="80.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="30.0" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="45.0" iyz="0.0"
               izz="55.0"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Left sliding door -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.885 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_material">
        <color rgba="0.9 0.9 0.9 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.885 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approximate mass 20 kg -->
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <origin xyz="-0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="5.0" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="8.0" iyz="0.0"
               izz="9.5"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Right sliding door -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.885 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_material">
        <color rgba="0.9 0.9 0.9 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.885 0.41 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approximate mass 20 kg -->
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0.4425 0 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="5.0" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="8.0" iyz="0.0"
               izz="9.5"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint for left door sliding along X -->
  <joint name="joint_left_door" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.885" upper="0.0" effort="200" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Joint for right door sliding along X -->
  <joint name="joint_right_door" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="-1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.885" upper="0.0" effort="200" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
